hypothesis: A qwen36 CUDA chain prompt chunk of more than 32 rows copies each staged layer's host-pool experts over the bus, all of them. A chunk of up to 256 rows routes to only a part of them, so copying just the experts its rows route to, after each such layer's router, makes a short prompt faster, with the same logits.
metric: prompt tok/s at 64 tokens, the prompt that opens the process (the first row of every run)
